description: Brings employees, leave and attendance over from the old AppSheet HRIS spreadsheets. Check first (nothing is saved), then Import. Running it again skips what was already imported. A team's supervisors with a login become its department's leave approvers when the department has none yet.

fields.options:

fields.label: Old HRIS Workbook
fields.description: The "Drea HR - HRIS" spreadsheet downloaded as .xlsx (File > Download > Microsoft Excel). Sheets used: A.01 Employee Database, A.02 Team Database, B.01 Attendance, C.01 Leave Balance, C.02 Leave Log.

fields.label: Older Attendance Files
fields.description: Optional: the yearly attendance archives from Drive (.xlsx, one tab per month), for attendance older than the B.01 sheet keeps.

fields.label: Default Company
fields.description: Employees whose old Business isn't matched to a company below go here, and so do new departments.

fields.label: Leave and Attendance From
fields.description: Leave, leave balances and attendance before this date are left out. Empty = everything.

fields.label: Create logins for active employees
fields.description: A login (no email is sent) for each active employee with an email address and no login yet, with HR roles for the old Admin and HR Team. HR sets their passwords.

fields.label: Annual Leave Type
fields.description: Old "Personal" leave paid from the quota, and the leave balances.

fields.label: Unpaid Leave Type
fields.description: Old "Personal" leave days that went over the quota.

fields.label: Other Special Leave Type
fields.description: Old "Special" leave (izin) whose reason doesn't name sick, wedding, birth, miscarriage or bereavement leave.

fields.label: Matching old values
fields.description: Filled in by Check. Choose what each old value becomes. Left empty: Business goes to the default company, Team becomes a new department, Type and Placement stay empty.

name: Old HRIS Import
